Class ClientModel

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.clientModelController.ClientModel
public class ClientModel extends Object
The core localized data container on the client side, implementing the Observer Pattern.

This class mirrors the server-side state to support fluid visual rendering without continuous network polling. It stores current board configurations (grid rows containing card unique IDs), information regarding the local user (homePlayer), structural registries of opponents, and localized grid tracking structures (such as offersPath sub-mappings per player count). It also hosts local business validation methods to check turn sequencing and row draft eligibility.

    • removePlayerFromTurnOrderCard

      public void removePlayerFromTurnOrderCard(String nickname)
      Blanks out a player nickname entry inside turn sequencing rows by overwriting it with null.

      Overwriting with a null placeholder keeps index alignments stable, preventing downstream indices from shifting up unexpectedly.

      Parameters:
      nickname - user string token undergoing placeholder purging

    • checkPickTurn

      public boolean checkPickTurn()
      Local logical checker determining if current board status allows the home player to pick a card.

      Evaluation logic:

      • Returns true instantly if the turn order card list size completely matches active player counts.
      • Bails out (returns false) if the player hasn't deployed their totem or occupies starter fallback slots like 'A'.
      • Scans opponent grid addresses to ensure no opponent totem occupies an earlier, higher-priority slot layout position.
      Returns:
      true if the active player turn matches home specifications; false otherwise

    • checkRow

      public boolean checkRow(int row)
      Verifies if a specific grid row is legally accessible for drafting based on the constraints of the home player's current track token position.

      Layout business logic parameters:

      • AddTopPick Bonus Flow: If the position pointer equals null, drafting is restricted exclusively to upper rows (Top Buildings/Deckable rows).
      • Top-Only Slots: Positions 'C' or 'F' lock choices, rejecting bottom row selections.
      • Bottom-Only Slots: Positions 'B' or 'D' reject upper tier selections, allowing drafts only from bottom rows.
      Parameters:
      row - target row index constant under validation
      Returns:
      true if the combination aligns with track slot rules; false otherwise
